Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE completely NEW square game-map ROOF-PLAN MATERIAL, opaque RGB, target1024x1024.
CAMERA: exact orthographic VERTICAL OVERHEAD, looking straight down90degrees. Only horizontal roof planes and courtyard paving. ZERO visible walls, facades, perspective elevations, building sides or vertical window rows. This is a flat roof plan texture, NOT an oblique town illustration.
STYLE reference: attached approved2029map is ONLY a guide to the warm cream paper, fine sepia pen and thin muted roof washes. Do NOT copy its streets, trees, parks, landmarks or oblique buildings. Use the same economical cartographer strokes and light gray-blue/ochre washes, not photographic textures.
TILING is the essential requirement: a periodic seamless repeat swatch, NOT a randomly cropped illustration. Left edge continues into right edge; top continues into bottom. Every roof ridge, roof outline and courtyard intersecting an edge has its EXACT matching continuation at the opposite edge at the same coordinate. Four corners meet continuously. Design the roof groups and cream gaps as an inherently repeating field. Equal detail, tone and spacing across the boundary and interior. No perimeter stroke, pale edge column, margin, straight seam or edge darkening. Fine paper grain has the same mean brightness across the whole tile.
NO trees, shrubs, grass, gardens, green courtyards, roads, street network, perimeter lines, cars, people, boats, lettering, symbols or landmarks. Courtyards are plain light cream STONE/PAPER only, never green. Roofs densely fill the surface as a seamless building material to be clipped into polygons by the game. Physical texture coverage roughly819x819metres. SUBJECT: dense connected Paris Haussmann roof groups, zinc-gray mansard roofs seen ONLY as top-down sloping planes with tiny pale dormer roof caps and chimneys, compact rectangular pale stone courtyards. Many small roof units. Sepia fine roof ridges, restrained cool gray slate wash, warm cream courtyards. No facade window rows or vertical walls.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new seamless square1024x1024 RGB WATER MATERIAL tile, directly overhead. Match ONLY the quiet gray-green water wash and delicate sepia-gray short horizontal undulating strokes of the river in the attached approved drawing. No city or land: the entire square is water. A mathematically periodic texture repeating in both directions: each horizontal wave crossing the right border resumes at exactly the same height, thickness and tone at the left border; top/bottom patterns also connect. This is a genuinely edge-wrapped repeat, not a cropped patch of an illustration.
